lines:
Responsibilities: Materializes the exact adapter set permitted for the authenticated host generation and resolves an approved binding to one versioned execution port. It combines built-in descriptors with core-attested provider, MCP, plugin, external-agent, and isolation handshakes without live substitution.
Owned runtime state: an immutable-per-generation index of CapabilityDescriptorV1 and AdapterManifestV1 keyed by logical capability ID plus version/hash. Descriptors declare input/output schemas, capability kind, side-effect class, idempotency/dedup guarantee, streaming and cancellation semantics, continuation/session/approval/MCP-forwarding features, secret slots, workspace/isolation needs, concurrency limits, supported platforms, and opaque-visibility limits.
Versioned ports and contracts: RegisterBuiltInV1, MaterializeAttestedSetV1, ResolveExactBindingV1, AdapterHandshakeV1, CapabilityHealthV1, and DescribeDegradedV1. ExtensionManifestV1 identity/version/hash and contribution facts must match the trusted core registry pin; a manifest describes capability but does not constrain trusted code.
Failure and degraded behavior: missing, disabled, incompatible, unhealthy, drifted, or hash-mismatched bindings return explicit definite-not-started diagnostics and are quarantined for new dispatch. No fallback or updated version is chosen silently.
Security truthfulness: discovery data is inert; the registry neither installs nor enables code. Trusted plugin descriptors are labelled host-authority and may bypass Aworkit brokers. A process descriptor is not a sandbox claim.
Observability, performance, and cross-platform behavior: deterministic indexed lookup, bounded handshake time, registry generation/hash metrics, capability-health snapshots, provenance diagnostics, and normalized path/platform matrices for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
Non-responsibilities: no extension identity/integrity authority, workflow capability binding, tier/route selection, approval, secret retrieval, adapter execution, or canonical inventory persistence.

data.name: Adapter Capability Descriptor Registry
data.technology: Rust immutable descriptor index and versioned adapter SPI
